notes: §1985:VI.7.3 presentation (kb/Work PB5212, landed): at --std 85 a debugging line that begins before the end of the OBJECT-COMPUTER paragraph (or, with none, before the Data Division) is COBOL7060, and a program that is not syntactically correct with its debugging lines taken as comment lines is COBOL7061 at the last kept line before the first syntax error. Both are refused below 2002 only. Witnesses: pb5212-debugging-line-before-object-computer and pb5212-debugging-line-syntax-both-ways (refuse-at 85, accepted where the presentation rule does not apply).
